services_summary:
select base,hh_group_code,min(date) first_date,max(date) last_date,
count(*) n,min(weight_sum) min_count,max(weight_sum) max_count
from cpi_czso.cpi_services group by all order by all
arithmetic_proof:
WITH expected as (
select date,base,hh_group_code,count(*) n,avg(value) arithmetic_mean,
exp(avg(ln(value))) geometric_mean
from cpi_czso.cpi_long
where subgroup_code='' and period_type='monthly' and coicop_code in ('06','08','10','11','12','13')
and value>0 group by all)
select s.date,s.base,s.hh_group_code,s.value stored_value,s.weight_sum,n,
arithmetic_mean,geometric_mean,s.value-arithmetic_mean difference_to_arithmetic,
s.value-geometric_mean difference_to_geometric
from cpi_czso.cpi_services s join expected e using(date,base,hh_group_code)
order by date,base,hh_group_code
category_coverage:
select coicop_code,coicop_label_cs,subgroup_code,subgroup_label_cs,base,hh_group_code,
min(date) first_date,max(date) last_date,count(*) n
from cpi_czso.cpi_long
where coicop_code in ('04','06','08','09','10','11','12','13')
group by all order by coicop_code,subgroup_code,base,hh_group_code
weights: select * from cpi_czso.cpi_weights order by basis_year,coicop_code
selected_category_levels:
select date,coicop_code,subgroup_code,subgroup_label_cs,base,value
from cpi_czso.cpi_long where subgroup_code in ('041','042','111','112','098','096')
and hh_group_code='0' and period_type='monthly'
order by subgroup_code,base,date
selected_calendar_audit:
select subgroup_code,subgroup_label_cs,base,
min(date) first_date,max(date) last_date,count(*) row_count,count(distinct date) unique_months,
date_diff('month',min(date),max(date))+1 expected_months
from cpi_czso.cpi_long where subgroup_code in ('041','042','111','112','098','096')
and hh_group_code='0' and period_type='monthly'
group by all order by subgroup_code,base
selected_transition:
with d as (
select date,coicop_code,subgroup_code,subgroup_label_cs,base,value,
100*(value/lag(value) over(partition by subgroup_code,base order by date)-1) mom_from_level
from cpi_czso.cpi_long where subgroup_code in ('041','042','111','112','098')
and hh_group_code='0' and period_type='monthly' and base='base_2015_eq_100')
select * from d where date between '2025-11-01' and '2026-02-28'
order by subgroup_code,date
services_base_sensitivity:
with d as (
select date,base,value,100*(value/lag(value) over(partition by base order by date)-1) mom
from cpi_czso.cpi_services where hh_group_code='0' and base in ('base_2015_eq_100','base_2025_eq_100'))
select a.date,a.value value_2015,b.value value_2025,a.mom mom_2015,b.mom mom_2025,
a.mom-b.mom difference_pp
from d a join d b using(date) where a.base='base_2015_eq_100' and b.base='base_2025_eq_100'
order by abs(a.mom-b.mom) desc
division_mixture_labels:
select distinct coicop_code,coicop_label_cs,subgroup_code,subgroup_label_cs
from cpi_czso.cpi_long where hh_group_code='0' and base='base_2015_eq_100'
and (subgroup_code='' or subgroup_code in ('041','042','081','083','094','096','098','073'))
order by coicop_code,subgroup_code
all_local_weight_tables:
select table_schema,table_name,column_name from information_schema.columns
where lower(table_name) like '%weight%' or lower(column_name) like '%weight%' order by all
